messages:
acme-customer: Hey team — redeemed promo code XYZ-TRIAL-2025 during onboarding, UI showed a green check and confirmation email, but org balance is still 0. Can someone confirm?

Sam (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste the code and your org_id? Also a screenshot if possible.

acme-customer: org_id=org_90431, code=XYZ-TRIAL-2025. Screenshot attached (shows checkmark).

Sam (Support): Thanks. I'm checking the redemption webhook and ledger now. @billing-bot can you dump recent voucher deliveries for code XYZ-TRIAL-2025?

billing-bot: voucher_webhook: {"code":"XYZ-TRIAL-2025","org_id":"org_90431","status":"acknowledged","http_status":200,"tx_id":"tx_88af3"} 

Sam (Support): Webhook returned 200 from grant-service and UI show success. Ledger query returning no credit for org_90431. Ping @Priya (Billing) for billing-profile mapping.

Priya (Billing): Looking now. Quick check: org_90431 has two billing_profile_ids historically: bp_11 (active) and bp_ghost_77 (legacy stale). The voucher grant system wrote to billing_profile bp_ghost_77. That profile is detached from any live billing account -> ledger processing skips detached profiles.

acme-customer: Is that why their UI confirmed but we didn't actually add funds?

Sam (Support): Likely — confirmation came from the grant ingestion path (webhook accepted) but ledger post step filtered out detached profiles. We'll need to either remap the grant to bp_11 or create a corrective ledger entry.

Luis (Eng): I can run a one-off remediation. Need the voucher tx_id (tx_88af3) and the account/org. Also paste the ingestion log lines. If we replay against the correct billing_profile_id it should create ledger credit.

Sam (Support): Here are the log snippets from grant-service: 
```
2025-06-02T14:12:08Z grant-service INFO grant_received tx=tx_88af3 code=XYZ-TRIAL-2025 org=org_90431 bp=bp_ghost_77
2025-06-02T14:12:09Z ledger-writer WARN billing_profile_detached bp=bp_ghost_77 skipping ledger write
```

Priya (Billing): Confirmed. bp_ghost_77.locked=true and was marked for migration two months ago. It never got mapped to the customer-facing billing account. We should avoid remapping automatically without audit. Recommend manual corrective ledger entry and a postmortem on grant routing.

Luis (Eng): Agreed. I'll create a safe remediation script: validate tx_id->org mapping, create ledger credit for org_90431 with metadata {source: "promo-manual-fix", original_tx: "tx_88af3"}, and mark tx as reconciled. Running in staging first. Command I'll use: 
```
# dry-run
python tools/remediate_voucher.py --tx tx_88af3 --target-bp bp_11 --dry-run
# apply
python tools/remediate_voucher.py --tx tx_88af3 --target-bp bp_11 --apply
```

Sam (Support): Thanks. Priya, please sign off the corrective entry.

Priya (Billing): Sign-off OK. Ensure ledger retention note and finance ticket. I'll file FIN-3987 for audit.

Luis (Eng): Running dry-run now...

billing-bot: dry-run result: {"tx":"tx_88af3","org":"org_90431","amount":20000,"currency":"USD_cents","target_bp":"bp_11","status":"dry-run-ok"} 

Luis (Eng): Dry-run looks good. Applying remediation in 2 mins.

Sam (Support): Notifying customer about expected 10-minute propagation.

acme-customer: Thanks — appreciate quick help.

billing-bot: remediation apply result: {"tx":"tx_88af3","created_ledger_entry":"led_9922","amount":20000,"status":"applied"} 

Sam (Support): Done — ledger entry led_9922 created for org_90431 for $200.00. Please refresh the billing page in ~5-10 minutes.

acme-customer: Checked now — balance shows $200 credit. All good. :tada:

Priya (Billing): I've attached FIN-3987 to the ledger entry for traceability. Also adding a follow-up to ensure grant-service verifies billing_profile.active before ack.

Luis (Eng): Filing ENG-10245 to add a check to grant-service: if billing_profile is detached then route to manual-review queue instead of auto-acking webhook.

Sam (Support): Closing this thread for now — will re-open if anything else. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
